p1.finding: The exact 2,530-cycle saving relies on child PWP SRAM write using the final accumulator update result in the same modeled cycle, but no executable RTL or synchronous-memory timing proof exists.
p1.impact: Separating child write by one cycle per edge preserves zero exposed transition stalls but reduces the modeled saving to 1,250 cycles and the isolated ratio to 1.00000355x.

p1.finding: No M275r2 RTL exists, so 96-byte weight and 144-byte PWP single-cycle ports, the 96-lane signed12 add/sub datapath, valid fences and role switching have no Synopsys VCS evidence.
p1.impact: The result is a modeled event-ledger feasibility result, not executable hardware timing.

p1.finding: The tree materializer changes 352,335,120 cycles by only 2,530 cycles (1.00000718x). The 1.540568x and 18.833223x values compare the complete PWP Conv path against bit-sparse and dense baselines.
p1.impact: Attributing either large ratio to materialization would be a headline-level misrepresentation.

p1.finding: There is no SRAM macro, DC/STA, switching activity, PTPX or DRAM/SRAM energy evaluation for the very wide ports and generated PWP traffic.
p1.impact: Payload reduction cannot yet be converted into area, frequency, power or energy benefit.

p2.finding: The 61,776-byte value excludes control flops, address/descriptor queues, banking overhead, ECC and macro rounding.
p2.impact: It is a logical storage lower bound, not implemented SRAM capacity or area.

p2.finding: Zero exposed stall applies to 17,270 in-sample transitions; each of ten samples separately pays a 707-cycle cold preparation and forbids cross-sample cache reuse.
p2.impact: Report cold costs and hidden transition costs separately.

p2.finding: The result covers a frozen ten-sample, four-Conv PAFT ep4 trace and one frozen Prim traversal order.
p2.impact: Generality across sequences, density strata, checkpoints and alternative traversal orders remains open.

p2.finding: Address ranges are logically bounded, but no physical bank decomposition demonstrates a practical 96B/144B macro interface at target frequency.
p2.impact: Keep capacity and port feasibility separate from physical macro admission.

publication_wording.safe: On the frozen ten-sample four-Conv trace, the complete modeled PWP Conv path takes 352,332,590 cycles versus 542,792,480 for bit-sparse and 6,635,558,400 for dense. Under the explicit single-port event ledger, all 17,270 in-sample preparations are hidden. Tree materialization itself reduces the stored-PWP total by only 2,530 cycles (1.00000718x).
publication_wording.required_caveat: The schedule has no RTL, VCS, SRAM macro, PPA or energy admission, and exact 2,530-cycle saving depends on the modeled final-update/child-write overlap.
forbidden: PPA, energy, system or headline result
